title: Quotient-and-lift: Puig_factorization G = O_p^'(G) * N_G(Z(L(S))) via the Frattini argument
intent: Prove the Bender-Glauberman factorization 'O_p^'(G) * 'N_G('Z('L(S))) = G (Theorem B.4(a)) for an odd, solvable group G by proving the key normality Z / D <| G / D in the quotient by D := 'O_p^'(G) — where Puig_center_normal supplies the normality in the quotient and Puig_sub identifies the quotient's center — and then lifting that normality back to G with the Frattini argument and the coset-preimage correspondence.

children.name: Puig_sub
children.note: L(G) is the last term of the Puig series of G; this lemma is the functoriality/subgroup fact the parent uses (through injmF and morphim_restrm) to identify the quotient's center Z / D with 'Z('L(S / D)) and to show Z is a subgroup of S. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the Puig subgroup L(G) is a subgroup of G

Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the center of the Puig subgroup L(S) is normal in G (Theorem B.4(b))

applicability.goal_shape: An equality of a group G with a product A * B — here 'O_p^'(G) * 'N_G('Z('L(S))) = G — where one factor is a normal subgroup D and the other a normalizer 'N_G(H), and the crux is a normality H / D <| G / D that is easier to prove in the quotient G / D because quotienting kills the obstruction (here D = 'O_p^'(G), so 'O_p^'(G / D) = 1).
applicability.use_when: a theorem about G is already proved for the case where a normal subgroup D is trivial (Puig_center_normal assumes 'O_p^'(G) = 1), and the general case reduces to it by quotienting out D; the lift back needs a Frattini-argument / coset-preimage step that a Sylow argument (morphim_pHall, Sylow_setI_normal, Frattini_arg) discharges.
applicability.avoid_when: the quotient does not kill the obstruction (here trivg_pcore_quotient must give 'O_p^'(G / D) = 1), or the lifted subgroup is not determined by its preimage (the coset-preimage step needs quotientK / quotientGK to apply); when the normality to lift is not itself obtained from a normality in the quotient plus a Frattini argument, the glue breaks.

consequences: The move creates three obligations: (i) identify the quotient's center, Z / D = 'Z('L(S / D)) (here def_Zq), discharged by Puig_sub through injmF and morphim_restrm; (ii) prove a normality in the quotient, Z / D <| G / D (here nZq), discharged by Puig_center_normal applied to the quotient whose p-core is trivial; (iii) lift the normality back to G, which here needs the Frattini argument (Frattini_arg p) plus the coset-preimage correspondence (cosetpre_normal, quotientK, quotientGK). Failure mode: the lift fails if the lifted subgroup is not determined by its preimage, or if the quotient has not actually trivialised the hypothesis Puig_center_normal requires (trivg_pcore_quotient).
